sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
Bachelor's applicant eligible in principle; minimum cumulative GPA3.0. Preparation: real analysis, modern
linear algebra, modern algebra; topology strongly recommended. Deficiencies addressed first year. [s1]
Before submission [2027 confirmed]
Choose Mathematics rather than Applied Mathematics; incorrect program requires reapplication. Finalize all
uploads before submission because materials cannot be updated. [s1]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
SOP should identify faculty fit; no prior supervisor agreement stated. Shortlist below includes current group
members; supervision availability unverified. [s1] [s9]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Application and recommendations checklist; reminders after 48hours if invitation missing; contact
math-gradadvising@ucdavis.edu for deadlines and portal-specific fields. [s1] [s3]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Department explicitly labeledFall 2027; central application is 2027-28. [s1]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
August 2025 table: TA approximatelyUSD1,964-4,168/month; GSR1,497-3,477/month, varying
appointment/step. Not a guaranteed yearly offer and not annualized. TA/GSR25%+ carry tuition/fee remission;
nonresident supplements via fellowships. Additional current evidence: the UC contract fixes Group 1
quarter-campus entry TA pay at USD 4,278 per month for a 50% appointment effective October 1, 2027. Nine
paid months would be USD 38,502 gross by arithmetic; this is a salary scale, not a guaranteed department
offer, appointment length, September payment, or summer award. Higher steps depend on qualifying
experience. [s5] [s18]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Most incoming PhD students receive five-year packages; master's funding not guaranteed. Summer
coverage/yearly total must be checked in offer. [s1] [s5]

International eligibility [Standing rule]
F1/J1 explicitly eligible employment statuses; nonresident-tuition fellowships available. Particular fellowship
nationality rules vary. [s5]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
GPA3.0,12units/quarter, satisfactory progress/duties and employment clearance. Academic employment
normallymax50%; teaching title15quarters(max18exception),research18(max21exception). [s5]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate TA application; automatic departmental consideration. Campus internal fellowships require
application in admission portal. [s1] [s5]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
GSR through funded faculty; nonresident tuition fellowships, internal awards and later
reader/associate-instructor jobs. [s5]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD155 international,USD135domestic; card at submission, separate fee per program, nonrefundable. [s1] [s6]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Central preparation-program waivers only domestic; Math explicitly offers no program waiver. Do not import
another Davis department's international fellowship process. [s1] [s6]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Eugene Gorsky (Gorskiy)
Hilbert schemes, braid/positroid varieties, affine Springer fibers and geometric representation theory. [s9] [s10]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Research evidence: 2026 · A geometric interpretation of the Delta Conjecture
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.
Representation theory
Erik Carlsson
Geometric representation theory, Macdonald polynomials and Hilbert schemes; recent work also computational
topology. [s11] [s17]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Research evidence: 2026 · Alpha shapes and optimal transport on the sphere
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.

Anne Schilling
Crystal bases, quantum algebras, algebraic combinatorics and symmetric/quasisymmetric functions. [s15] [s17]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Research evidence: 2026preprint · Contractions and applications of crystal skeletons: Young quasisymmetric and Stanley
symmetric functions
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.
Monica Vazirani
Hecke/DAHA/KLR algebras and crystals; official linked publication page is old, so recent-paper verification
incomplete. [s16] [s17]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Research evidence: 2011 - historical, not recent · Crystals from categorified quantum groups
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.
Complex geometry
Adam Jacob
Complex differential geometry, Hermitian-Yang-Mills equations, geometric flows and mirror symmetry. [s12]
[s17]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Research evidence: 2025 · Singularity formation along the line bundle mean curvature flow
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.
Number theory
Elena Fuchs
Arithmetic thin groups, Apollonian packings, Markoff dynamics and cryptography. [s13] [s17]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Research evidence: undated current submitted manuscript · Primes represented by shifted quadratic forms: on primitivity and
congruence classes
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.
Junxian Li
Analytic number theory, automorphic forms, L-functions and shifted convolution. [s14] [s17]
Current faculty affiliation verified; 2027 supervision availability not stated.
Research evidence: 2026 · A higher rank shifted convolution problem with applications to L-functions
Topic evidence from the official faculty publication page.
